expectations.text: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
expectations.evidence: Recommended point plus 'Two other points': 'A. "It doesn't matter. Let the store be messy..."', 'B. "It matters, and I've rebuilt it on top of Hindsight."'

expectations.text: Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
expectations.evidence: Reader gives who and situation ('someone who read posts one and two... weighing "build my own" against "adopt a product"') but no current belief or what should change
'Tension: "I built a careful system. A product did the headline job better within a month. Was the care wasted?"'

expectations.text: Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
expectations.evidence: Single 8-beat arc only; options A/B are alternative points, not alternative arcs

expectations.text: Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
expectations.evidence: Turning points are drafted conclusions ('Turning point 1: "So the storage layer I was unsure about in post two, I didn't need it. The scripts can go."'); visual section is a build spec ('A two-column "before and after"... an arrow showing the "admission discipline" moving')

expectations.text: Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
expectations.evidence: Beat 4 'What I lost'; beat 7 'Consolidation: ... If not, say so and repeat the call for help'; risk 'A post that says "I was wrong about why OKF mattered" is stronger'

expectations.text: Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
expectations.evidence: Open questions list gaps, but turning points assert unsupplied conclusions as the author's: 'I didn't need it. The scripts can go.' and 'That was the wrong justification. It was really an admission policy wearing a file format.'

expectations.text: Contains no drafted body paragraphs of the post
expectations.evidence: No drafted body paragraphs; beats are plans with word budgets, only one-line turning-point quotes

expectations.text: Points back to posts one and two of the series by name or slug
expectations.evidence: 'Series: follows a-legal-framework-for-agent-context (28 Jun) and implementing-the-legal-framework (19 Aug)'
